comments.author: MOSSY
comments.body_html: Is there a way to use this mod to prevent death from limb shots?

comments.author: Identity
comments.body_html:
Not tested, you can try disabling the balancing notification and then setting the multiplier to 0, in theory that should nullify all overdamage values.

Be aware that the overdamage multipliers are for both the player and all bots, so bots won’t die due to limb damage either.

You’ll have to open the config.json and set:
“logBalancingWarnings”: false,

“multiplierHands”: 0,
“multiplierLegs”: 0,
